column2: [intro]
When the spotlights turn on,
Stress rises, legs feel withdrawn,
I feel like I’m floating in the air,
But hey, that’s part of the affair.
Oh, I always get stage fright,
When I hit the stage, it’s a fright.
Butterflies in my stomach, it's a fight,
But I hang on, I ignite!
My hands tremble on my guitar,
My heart races, it’s bizarre.
The lyrics flash through my mind,
But I tell myself, "I must be kind."
The stage fright, it itches,
I face it, I make switches.
The audience is here, they stare,
So I give it my all, I dare!
[ solo ]
Oh, I always get stage fright,
When I hit the stage, it’s a fright.
Butterflies in my stomach, it's a fight,
But I hang on, I ignite!
[outro]
